description.en: Used by the skill scene script (ie4_ev_sub_skl.nut) to read the participants set with the CMND_SETUP_SKL_SQ_* commands: for the given numbers of attackers and defenders it fills the array with their data (character, kit, preloaded model and position). The last two arguments are the script's chara_copy pair (a side name and a count), which, by the names, makes the scene reuse a participant for copies.
Receives the participants' data (the script passes array(12, 0)).
Always null; the results are in the array.

examples.case: In the skill scene script (real usage, from ie4_ev_sub_skl.nut)
